strongest_angle: Examining how international authorities including Eurojust and Økokrim dismantled a supplier involved in bribery and fraud affecting NATO naval operations, leading to arrests in Norway and searches in Germany and Romania.

key_facts.fact: Five people were arrested in the Bergen area of Norway by Økokrim in connection with an investigation into fraud against NATO involving EUR 1 million.
Searches were carried out in Germany and Romania as part of a wider international police operation coordinated by Eurojust targeting NATO ship contracts.
The European Union's criminal justice agency Eurojust coordinated the joint investigation that took down a company suspected of bribery and EUR 1 million fraud supplied to NATO vessels.

numbers.label: Fraud amount linked to NATO contracts
